(1) sperm cells act as transgenerational vectors for somatic cell‐derived RNA‐encoded genetic information, and (2) LINE‐1‐encoded RT plays an important role in the process.
spermatozoa can acquire genetic information from the environment and transmit it to the next generation via LINE‐1‐derived RT.
sperm cells can inherit extrachromosomal somatic‐derived genetic information via a mechanism that involves LINE‐1 RT and is likely to modify the developmental trajectory of early embryos.

a novel mechanism of transgenerational inheritance of extrachromosome genetic information.
the mechanisms of transgenerational inheritance and its role in the evolution of multicellular organisms.
the role of LINE‐1 RT in the transmission of extrachromosome genetic information across the Weismann Barrier and its impact on the developmental fate of the next generation.

sperm‐borne genetic information is a major source of genetic variation in the next generation.
